display: Krishna as the Vraja infant and toddler

depiction_rules.notes: D045 follows Krishna from crawling infant through early toddlerhood. Use one age-appropriate two-armed child form in every stanza; the chapter never depicts an extra-armed physical form. In stanza 11–12, universal divinity is shown through surrounding cosmic imagery, not duplicate bodies or added limbs.

visual_bible.age: small infant in stanzas 1–5, mobile toddler in stanzas 6–10, still a young child in stanzas 11–12; do not age him into a school-age child
visual_bible.face: rounded child face, soft cheeks, calm dark almond eyes; maintain recognizable features across scenes
visual_bible.skin: deep matte indigo-blue mineral pigment; sample skin-only areas with blue-minus-red at least 40; never pale blue, gray, glossy or neon
visual_bible.hair: short dark curls appropriate to a young child
visual_bible.build: believable infant or toddler proportions with ordinary human anatomy, exactly one head, two attached arms, two hands, two legs and two feet
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted golden-yellow or cream child cloth; modest scale-appropriate ornaments such as anklets and small armlets when called for by the scene; no royal costume
visual_bible.forehead: plain and bare, without tilak or mark
visual_bible.style: full-bleed South Indian temple mural with firm dark contours and flat matte mineral fields

continuity_markers: Deep indigo child Krishna with short dark curls, bare forehead, simple muted yellow cloth, age-appropriate infant/toddler proportions and ordinary two-arm/two-leg anatomy.
never: no duplicate physical Krishna within a scene
no adult proportions, tall crown, forehead mark or royal costume
no pale, gray, glossy, violet or neon skin
no text, watermark, signature or copied overlay
